title: A variable remembers a value.
heading: A variable remembers a value.
description: Give a value a name so you can use it again.
placeholder: Try it on the next slide

explanation.title: Store the name
explanation.text: The = stores the text Ola in a variable called username.

explanation.title: Read it with print()
explanation.text: print() shows a value in the Output. Python looks up username and prints Ola. Without quotes, username means the variable; "username" would just be text.

explanation.title: More fun: let the fox say it
explanation.text: The fox says Ola in a speech bubble. Same stored value, shown in the scene instead of the Output.
